**Finding: Compliant** (no redline)

Section 22 is the only audit right binding us, and it satisfies the **preferred** position on all material terms:

| Term | Preferred | § 22 |
|---|---|---|
| Frequency | ≤1 / 12 months | once in any twelve-month period ✓ |
| Notice | 30 days' written | at least thirty days' prior written ✓ |
| Timing | business hours | normal business hours, no unreasonable disruption ✓ |
| Auditor | independent, confidentiality-bound | ✓ (and off-site where practicable) |
| Cost | Vendor's, unless underpayment >5% | ✓ (>5% shifts reasonable costs + undisputed shortfall) |
| System access | none | expressly barred, plus unrelated Customer Data, privileged material and third-party supplier confidential info ✓ |

Section 22.3 adds further customer-side protection (findings are our Confidential Information, enforcement-only use, copy of the final report, and payment of a shortfall closes the audited quantity issue absent fraud or demonstrable error). A document-wide search for audit/inspection/verification/monitoring/remote-access language surfaced no other right running against us; § 23 (Records and Customer Assurance) contains no operative audit provision.
